thread:
Aisha K: Midday roundup — queue at 28 open tickets, 3 P1s, 6 P2s. P1s: T-1129 (billing double-charge), T-1210 (streaming timeout), T-1214 (dedicated deploy failure). I updated refund and deploy-escalation macros. Links to logs and customer notes: https://redwood.atlassian/links/triage/1702003456. Who can pick up the streaming timeout?

Ben D: Taking T-1210 (streaming timeout). ETA ~45m. Initial repro shows repeated 'gRPC cancel' from ash-prod-3 after 60s. I'll attach traces and enable verbose logging. Added a debug macro draft: `streaming-timeout-debug`.

Luca R: I'll own T-1214 (deploy failure). Early signal points to image-pull rate limits in eu-west. Preparing a burst-capacity patch and a rollback plan. If we need to pause the rollout, ping me.

Marta (oncall): On T-1129 (billing double-charge) — I've contacted the customer and billing ops, flagged as P1 for finance. Using refund-template v2 macro for now. ETA 30m for initial remediation steps. Note: if customer on Dedicated, route to acct-team for contract check.

ticket-bot: 1702003465 - New comment on T-1210 by Ben D: "attaching full grpc trace and req ids" https://tickets.redwood/T-1210

Aisha K: Quick ask — can eng review CR #4526 (billing reconciliation edge-case)? @Luca R @Ben D please. It's a small change to reconciliation window that will reduce noise / false-duplicates. Ideally merge before evening deploy.

Ben D: Will review after I finish the trace for T-1210. If it's a tiny change we can merge and include in the post-deploy config.

Luca R: I'll take a look now. If we need a canary bump I'll coordinate with infra.

Aisha K: Also proposal: standardize support macros with these fields: "what we did", "customer impact", "rollforward", "rollback", "owner". I'll draft a template in #support-docs and port refund-template. Thoughts?

Marta (oncall): Love it — should make handoffs much smoother during nights/weekends.

Ben D: +1. Can we also add an 'estimated ticket age' line that ticket-bot can populate automatically? Would help prioritize.

ticket-bot: Feature suggestion logged: ticket-bot#789 - auto-estimated-age for macros and headers.

Aisha K: Great. Last call: does anyone need handoff at 5pm? If not I'll run the evening pulse and set the macro updates live. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Luca R: None from me, I'll stay on the deploy until it's resolved.

Marta (oncall): I'll take overnight ownership on billing if it's not closed by EOD.

Ben D: If streaming timeout >1hr I'll escalate to oncall rotation and post an incident stub.

Aisha K: Thanks all — keep comments inline on the relevant tickets. I'll update the macros and drop a short blurb in #ops-updates once refund-template v2 is live. :white_check_mark:
